span.p:
ONE thread, one event loop.
Each await hands control back to the loop,
which runs whichever task is ready.

div.style: color: rgb(31, 35, 40) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
So a BLOCKING call inside async def
(time.sleep, requests.get) freezes every task —
nothing else can run. That is S5's hypothesis #1.
